rules: Only the original fixed Pattern 0110 task, 11 inputs and 8 ReLU hidden units; no transfer or other bit patterns.
Exactly three assignment classes: fixed C0=0 and two unconstrained trainable scalars C1,C2. A shared hidden bias, shared readout and output offset give five numerical parameters.

Initialize C1 below zero and C2 above zero with independent random magnitudes to align arbitrary code names across numerical replicas; signs, order, values and positions remain unconstrained during learning. No analytic filter values are supplied.
Search receives support/query observations only. No true windows, active-edge count, group capacities or ground-truth index labels enter initialization, loss or selection.
Alternate three support numeric Adam updates and one architecture-query update. Compare constant softmax with temperature annealing and late entropy minimization.
Compare no sparsity penalty with a generic 0.01 mean active-probability penalty; no target number of active connections is supplied.

At registered checkpoints take argmax, keep inherited codebooks, canonicalize only by global swapping of the two nonzero labels and hidden-column permutation, and fine-tune only the five numerical parameters. Adam moments reset.

Each numerical replica chooses its checkpoint by query BCE. Mean selection BCE across all four inherited numerical replicas selects search checkpoints/configurations. Ground-truth agreement and test labels never rank candidates.

Confirm the best two configurations on three new search seeds with first-order and one-step unrolled controls. Choose configuration/order by the average over seeds after per-seed checkpoint selection, then choose a primary seed by selection BCE.

Keep the source-selected pilot winner as a separate pre-test reference. Calibrate fresh-codebook rate and scale on selection BCE only, freeze, then evaluate on the disjoint 512-input test and all 2048 inputs.
Fresh-codebook calibration/evaluation uses both global permutations of the two signed initial code values equally often; no sign or order constraint is maintained during optimization.

Report exact categorical recovery after global code renaming and hidden-column matching, binary precision/recall/F1, classification metrics, actual loss/recall curves, P0/P1/P2 and selected indexator heatmaps.
Oracle I and its analytic parameters are used only after model selection for diagnostics. No software tests, commits or publication.
